blockers.summary: Canonical candidate control file SHA did not equal fetched source branch head.
blockers.details: Candidate control recorded 9e275e28a80cc8bf7fa82ade1092cd8cc21510d4 while fetched source branch head was dfef7de2035e08f1ee72e0133ccf656fe7a74444. Candidate SHA is an ancestor and post-candidate diff was classified as control/format-only.
blockers.resolution: Branch from fetched source head and record candidate code SHA separately in INPUTS/STATE/DECISIONS.
